Configure your products live in 3D and increase conversion by integrating them into your online shop and make them available for your sales teams and customers. </p></div><div class="text--left padding-medium-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/3d_furniture_configurator" target="_blank">LEARN MORE</a></div></div></div><div class="row padding-small-top padding-medium-bottom"><div class="align-v-center col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><h4 class="text--left padding-small-top"><strong>Augmented Reality</strong></h4><div class="paragraph inline_content_container text--justify"><p>Augmented Reality is changing the way how furniture is purchased online &amp; offline today. Convince your customers and increase your sales conversion online. Your products digitally available in every room via mobile devices with the Apple ARKit. Ready for all new AR/VR platforms (Google ARCore &amp; Tango, Microsoft HoloLens, ...)</p></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6"><div class="text--left padding-medium-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/augmented-reality" target="_blank">Learn more</a></div></div></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><a class="image__link inline-block padding-big-bottom" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/augmented-reality" target="_blank"><figure class="inline-block figure--centered"><img alt="Augmented Reality product visualization" class="lazyload" data-src="//img2.storyblok.com/480x0/f/39834/480x380/cc0ff0722d/roomle_ar_with_apple_ar_kit.jpg" src="https://img2.storyblok.com/25x0/f/39834/480x380/cc0ff0722d/roomle_ar_with_apple_ar_kit.jpg"/></figure></a></div></div><div class="row padding-small-top padding-medium-bottom"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><a class="image__link inline-block padding-small-bottom" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/hd-renderings" target="_blank"><figure class="inline-block figure--centered"><img alt="HD renderings of furniture and interiors" class="lazyload" data-src="//img2.storyblok.com//f/39834/480x380/30706baf86/roomle_hd_renderings_furniture.jpg" src="https://img2.storyblok.com/25x0/f/39834/480x380/30706baf86/roomle_hd_renderings_furniture.jpg"/></figure></a></div><div class="align-v-center col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><h4 class="text--right"><strong>HD Renderings</strong> (CGI images)
</h4><div class="paragraph inline_content_container text--justify"><p>Photorealistic renderings of your furniture products and variations produced in any material, views, compilations, scenes, lighting and style. Our CGI solution enables you to automate your content production process with direct integration into your own systems or online shop. No need for expensive and time consuming photoshoots anymore.</p></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6"></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6"><div class="text--right padding-medium-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/hd-renderings" target="_blank">Learn more</a></div></div></div></div></div><div class="row padding-small-top padding-medium-bottom"><div class="align-v-center col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><h4 class="text--right padding-small-top"><strong>2D &amp; 3D Floor planner</strong></h4><div class="paragraph inline_content_container text--justify"><p>The roomle 2D/3D floor planning functionality lets you build, design and furnish rooms and make it available across multiple destinations without any special skills. Integrate your branded roomle floor planner with your individual products into your website.</p></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-4 col-lg-4"><div class="text--center padding-small-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/3d_floorplanner" target="_blank">Learn more</a></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-4 col-lg-4"><div class="text--center padding-small-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/demo-floor-plans" target="_self">Demo plans</a></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-4 col-lg-4"><div class="text--center padding-small-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/roomle-service" target="_blank">SERVICES</a></div></div></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><a class="image__link inline-block padding-small-bottom" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/3d_floorplanner" target="_blank"><figure class="inline-block figure--centered"><img alt="roomle 3D floorplanner for web, iOS and Android" class="lazyload" data-src="//img2.storyblok.com//f/39834/2c13c6de90/roomle_live_3d_view_floor_plans.jpg" src="https://img2.storyblok.com/25x0/f/39834/2c13c6de90/roomle_live_3d_view_floor_plans.jpg"/></figure></a></div></div><div class="row padding-small-top padding-medium-bottom"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><figure class="inline-block figure--centered padding-medium-top padding-small-bottom"><img alt="Digital_POS_3D/AR_sales_tools_furniture_retail_and_shop-fitting_industry" class="lazyload" data-src="//img2.storyblok.com//f/39834/3088x1757/d569fa14ed/roomle_retail.jpg" src="https://img2.storyblok.com/25x0/f/39834/3088x1757/d569fa14ed/roomle_retail.jpg"/></figure></div><div class="align-v-center col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><h4 class="text--left"><strong>Enhance POS</strong> - digital 3D/AR sales solution
</h4><div class="paragraph inline_content_container text--justify"><p>Empower your sales teams by providing them with your entire digital inventory fully configurable in 3D and Augmented Reality across multiple platforms (web &amp; mobile). Plan, furnish and configure your products together with your customers and convince them with best-in-class 3D/AR visualization. And finally generate and integrate planning-based order lists into your internal systems.</p></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6"><div class="text--left padding-small-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/furniture-retail" target="_blank">FOR RETAILERS</a></div></div><div class="col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6 col-lg-6"><div class="text--left padding-medium-bottom"><a class="button" href="//www.roomle.com/en/business/shopffiting" target="_blank">FOR POS/SHOP-FITTERS</a></div></div></div></div></div><div class="row padding-medium-top padding-medium-bottom"><div class="align-v-center col-xs-12 col-sm-12 col-md-6"><h4 class="text--right padding-small-top"><strong>Onlineshop integration</strong></h4><div class="paragraph inline_content_container text--justify"><p>Convince your clients and increase conversion. Simply embed a white-label version of the roomle 3D furniture configurator into your website/web shop and make individual products available for online sales.
